question_text: Construct SQL using Employee(EmployeeID, RoleID, FirstName, Surname) and Role(RoleID, Grade) to return FirstName, Surname, Grade for employees whose surname is Patel and grade is 8.
adaptation_rationale: Retains two-table query construction with new schema/filter and correct consistent table names.
solution: SELECT e.FirstName,e.Surname,r.Grade FROM Employee AS e JOIN Role AS r ON e.RoleID=r.RoleID WHERE e.Surname='Patel' AND r.Grade=8;

marking_points.criterion: Combines surname and grade conditions using AND.
